clips.title: The story
paras: In the Pools of Vision, Clarice Foster lives among tauren seers and mystics. Far from Lordaeron, the Forsaken woman spends her days in contemplation beneath the bluffs of Mulgore.

Most Forsaken remain in Lordaeron, rebuilding their kingdom beneath the Undercity. Clarice Foster has traveled to the heart of tauren lands in Kalimdor. She lives in the cavernous Pools of Vision beneath the mesa of Thunder Bluff, among Forsaken apothecaries and tauren shamans who study the spiritual and elemental mysteries of the earth.
